spec.title: Balanced Aid to Secure the Right
spec.line: A sanctuary relocated to the right, guarded by loyal turrets.
spec.rationale: Moving the sanctuary to the right and reducing bullet speed to slow costs 3 benefit points (2 for zone, 1 for slow). Reinforcements pay 3 points, matching the benefit total. Reflection is omitted to maintain balance as total benefit must not exceed price points.
